children: Exports surged 68.7% yoy to USD 98.25 billion in August 2026, surpassing market estimates of 62.6% and accelerating from an upwardly revised 63% jump in July.
Exports rose for the 15th consecutive month, marking the third-highest monthly figure on record, after sales exceeded USD 100 billion for the first time in June.
The increase was driven by strong demand for memory chips, with semiconductor exports rising for the 15th consecutive month.

title: South Korea Exports Rise More than Expected
